lines.speaker: ishita
lines.text: Ek minute! Sirf ninety-nine rupaye mein game? Itna sasta... bharosa kaise karein?

lines.speaker: shubh
lines.text: Arre Nikki, tension mat le! Sab kuch proof ke saath hai.

lines.speaker: manan
lines.text: Cheap PC Games Store GST registered hai... aur Udyam registered bhi!

lines.speaker: shubh
lines.text: Two thousand plus happy customers! Sab trust karte hain!

lines.speaker: manan
lines.text: Aur proof chahiye? Website pe neeche scroll karo... har delivery ka WhatsApp screenshot upload hai!

lines.speaker: ishita
lines.text: Wow! Itna transparent? Phir toh main bhi aaj hi game le rahi hoon!

lines.speaker: manan
lines.text: Trusted store, genuine games... sirf ninety-nine rupaye se! Link bio mein hai!
